newsitem.title: USA: Consumers Financial looking at its options.
newsitem.headline: Consumers Financial looking at its options.

text.p: Consumers Financial Corp said Wednesday that it was still considering a strategic move, such as selling all or part of the company, and would proceed with one of the options by the end of the year.

The options being considered include the sale of the insurance operations, the sale of the automobile auction business, the sale of the entire company or a combination of the company with another organization, Consumers Financial said.
There are no assurances that any deal would be completed in 1996, it said.
The company said in March that it had retained a financial adviser to assist in evaluating various alternatives for "preserving shareholder value."
